8. Banking & Financial Services 🏦
•Immediate Impact: Limited direct impact, but prolonged disruptions in consumer spending and businesses could increase credit risks.
•Past Evidence:
◦During SARS and COVID-19, financial institutions faced rising NPAs and slowing loan growth.
◦The BFSI sector rebounded as economic activity picked up post-crisis.
•Outlook: Watch for any slowdown in business activity, but minimal immediate impact expected. 

9. Entertainment & Media 🎥
•Immediate Impact:
◦Cinemas and live events: Likely to face reduced footfalls.
◦Streaming services: Could see a boost as people spend more time at home.
•Past Evidence: OTT platforms like Netflix, Amazon Prime, and Disney+ saw record growth during COVID-19 lockdowns.
•Outlook: A short-term hit for physical venues, but digital entertainment will thrive.

nodes.author: Rajneesh__jha
nodes.text:
Conclusion: A Balanced Perspective
The HMPV virus could create short-term disruptions, especially in travel, hospitality, and aviation. However, resilient sectors like pharma, IT, and FMCG are likely to remain unaffected or even see growth.
